title: Prove a sharp weighted region for the mixed UT4 target
body:
Resolve Nick Petalas’s PR #2175 weighted-tariff handoff for `diag([z],[uz],I_rest)` in the full formal UT4(F2) rank-one alphabet. Every fourteen-call word, on any finite number of arbitrary restored dirty registers, has counts `(a,b,c)=(4,6,4)`. The open five-b alternatives `(5,5,4)` and `(4,5,5)` are excluded.

The written proof applies the credited mixed-middle and common-orientation span arguments at fourteen calls. This reduces arbitrary workspace to the two active roles while preserving every count. The extended exact census rejects all 421,888 expanded new candidates in the complete necessary quotient and reproduces the predecessor’s thirteen-call transcript byte for byte.

The new weighted consequence is a sharp region: for nonnegative letter prices with `beta <= 2 min(alpha,gamma)`, the exact minimum is `4 alpha + 6 beta + 4 gamma`, attained by the credited direct word. The general lower envelope and its limits are stated explicitly; no five-b word, optimum outside that region, native supplier or new kappa is claimed.

Validation: full registered CPython 3.12 replay with assertions disabled, including all 907,200 five-call gap realizations, a separate quotient oracle on 20,440 short words, 4,096 literal group products, 192 faithful dirty-input columns, planted reconstruction, orientation/price-boundary controls and fourteen omitted-call plus wrong-letter rejections. Both commands reproduce from a Git-free, read-only CPython 3.14 export without changing its twelve files.

Only `research/ut4-mixed-weighted-boundary/` is added. One actually used predecessor library is retained unchanged and pinned; source proofs and the original control receipt retain their authors’ credit. The unit minimum fourteen, direct word and profile/quotient/compression methods are predecessor work. No selected or frozen source changes.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2019#discussioncomment-18940717. Prepared by Gareth Davidson / @bitplane with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human review.

Final freshness: canonical main and PR2175 unchanged; complete live pagination covered 527 open PRs and 1,023 Discussion records with no warnings.
